C046.name: Kibaha Town Council
C046.documented: Ruvu and coastal-plain floods, heavy Masika and Vuli rain, strong winds, and cholera

area.en: Kibaha Town: highway corridor and industrial areas
area.sw: Mji wa Kibaha: ukanda wa barabara kuu na maeneo ya viwanda

risk.en: This area is a fast-growing town on the Dar–Morogoro highway with factories, where storm run-off floods roadside settlements and industrial fires and spills can occur.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji unaokua kwa kasi kando ya barabara kuu ya Dar–Morogoro wenye viwanda, ambapo maji ya dhoruba hufurika makazi ya kando ya barabara na moto au kumwagika kwa kemikali kunaweza kutokea viwandani.

advice.en: For those living and working here, it helps to keep drains and culverts clear, build outside the road reserve and keep fire extinguishers and exits ready at workplaces. What raises the risk: building inside the road reserve and over the culverts, filling drains with waste, and blocking factory exits with stock or locking them during shifts. Know the higher ground away from the roadside drains that your household will move to when storm water rises, and the assembly point outside the factory fence that workers will go to if fire or a chemical leak starts; move when the alarm sounds, not when the smoke is seen. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya kazi hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na makalavati wazi, kujenga nje ya hifadhi ya barabara na kuweka vizimamoto na njia za kutokea tayari kazini. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ndani ya hifadhi ya barabara na juu ya makalavati, kujaza mitaro taka, na kuziba njia za kutokea za viwanda kwa mizigo au kuzifunga wakati wa zamu. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mitaro ya barabarani ambalo kaya yako itahamia maji ya dhoruba yanapopanda, na kituo cha kukusanyika nje ya uzio wa kiwanda ambacho wafanyakazi wataenda moto au uvujaji wa kemikali ukianza; ondokeni kengele inapolia, si moshi unapoonekana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C051.name: Kibiti Town Council
C051.documented: Rufiji delta floods, large waves, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Kibiti Town: Rufiji delta edge and highway
area.sw: Mji wa Kibiti: pembezoni mwa delta ya Rufiji na barabara kuu

risk.en: This area lies at the edge of the Rufiji delta on the coastal highway, where floods cut the road and low areas, and mosquitoes spread malaria after rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko pembezoni mwa delta ya Rufiji kando ya barabara kuu ya pwani, ambapo mafuriko hukata barabara na maeneo ya chini, na mbu husambaza malaria baada ya mvua.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep homes above the flood line, plan travel around flood periods and sleep under treated nets. What raises the risk: building new houses on the low ground below the flood line, driving through flooded sections of the highway, and leaving water standing in containers after the rains. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the delta floods, and go before the road is cut, taking documents and medicines; do not cross flooded road sections on foot or in a vehicle, however shallow they look. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya mstari wa mafuriko, kupanga safari kuzingatia vipindi vya mafuriko na kulala ndani ya vyandarua vyenye dawa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba mpya kwenye ardhi ya chini ya mstari wa mafuriko, kupita kwa gari sehemu za barabara kuu zilizofurika, na kuacha maji yakituama kwenye vyombo baada ya mvua. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia delta inapofurika, na ondokeni kabla barabara haijakatika, mkichukua nyaraka na dawa; msivuke sehemu za barabara zilizofurika kwa miguu au kwa gari, hata zionekane za kina kifupi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C043.name: Bagamoyo District Council
C043.documented: coastal floods, large waves, Ruvu floods, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Bagamoyo: coast, Ruvu delta and old town
area.sw: Bagamoyo: pwani, delta ya Ruvu na mji wa kale

risk.en: This area has a low coastline with erosion and storm tides threatening the old town and beaches, and the Ruvu and Wami deltas that flood farms and villages.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina pwani ya chini yenye mmomonyoko na mawimbi makubwa yanayohatarisha mji wa kale na fukwe, na delta za Ruvu na Wami zinazofurika mashamba na vijiji.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to build back from the shoreline, protect mangroves and keep homes off the river flood plains. What raises the risk: building on the beach front or on the delta flats, cutting mangroves for poles or plots, mining sand from the shore and going out in loaded boats when the wind is rising. Know the higher ground inland that your village will move to when a storm-tide or strong-wind warning is given, and the ground above the Ruvu and Wami flood plains that your household will go to when the rivers rise; move before the water reaches the road. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe, kulinda mikoko na kujenga nje ya tambarare za mafuriko za mito. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ufukweni au kwenye tambarare za delta, kukata mikoko kwa ajili ya nguzo au viwanja, kuchimba mchanga ufukweni na kutoka baharini kwa vyombo vilivyojaa upepo unapopanda. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba au upepo mkali inapotolewa, na eneo lililo juu ya tambarare za mafuriko za Ruvu na Wami ambalo kaya yako itaenda mito inapojaa; ondokeni kabla maji hayajafika barabarani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C044.name: Chalinze District Council
C044.documented: Ruvu floods, heavy rain, and strong winds on the coastal plain

area.en: Chalinze: Wami river plains and highway junction
area.sw: Chalinze: tambarare za mto Wami na makutano ya barabara

risk.en: This area has the Wami river plains that flood in heavy rains, dry grazing land where herders and farmers compete, and a busy highway junction.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare za mto Wami zinazofurika wakati wa mvua kubwa, ardhi kame ya malisho ambapo wafugaji na wakulima hushindania ardhi, na makutano ya barabara yenye shughuli nyingi.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes and stores off the flood plain, follow village land-use plans and trade outside the road reserve. What raises the risk and to the quarrels in a dry year: building homes and stores on the Wami flood plain, cutting fields across the livestock routes or driving herds onto cropped land, and trading inside the road reserve at the junction. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the Wami spreads over the plains, and agree early, between farmers and herders, where the herds will water in a failed season; settle it before the dry months, not during them. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga makazi na maghala nje ya tambarare ya mafuriko, kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi ya vijiji na kufanya biashara nje ya hifadhi ya barabara. Kinachoongeza hatari na migogoro mwaka wa ukame: kujenga nyumba na maghala kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Wami, kulima kuvuka njia za mifugo au kuingiza mifugo kwenye mashamba yenye mazao, na kufanya biashara ndani ya hifadhi ya barabara kwenye makutano. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia Wami inapotapakaa tambarareni, na kubalianeni mapema, wakulima na wafugaji, mifugo itanyweshwa wapi msimu ukikosekana; maamuzi yafanyike kabla ya miezi ya kiangazi, si katikati yake. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C045.name: Kibaha District Council
C045.documented: Ruvu floods, heavy rain, and cholera after floodwater

area.en: Kibaha DC: Ruvu river and farmland
area.sw: Kibaha DC: mto Ruvu na mashamba

risk.en: This area has the Ruvu river valley, which floods farms and crossings and supplies Dar es Salaam's water, and farmland where dry spells damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina bonde la mto Ruvu, linalofurika mashamba na vivuko na kusambaza maji ya Dar es Salaam, na mashamba ambapo vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes off the river banks, protect the river from pollution and plant drought-tolerant crops. What raises the risk and to the loss in a dry year: farming and building right on the Ruvu bank, washing, dumping waste or spraying chemicals near the river that supplies the city, and relying on maize alone. Know the higher ground away from the river that your household will move to when the Ruvu rises, and do not cross the flooded crossings on foot; agree early where food will come from in a failed season, before the stores are empty. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na kingo za mto, kulinda mto dhidi ya uchafuzi na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara mwaka wa ukame: kulima na kujenga moja kwa moja kwenye ukingo wa Ruvu, kuosha, kutupa taka au kupulizia kemikali karibu na mto unaosambaza maji jijini, na kutegemea mahindi pekee. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mto ambalo kaya yako itahamia Ruvu inapojaa, na msivuke vivuko vilivyofurika kwa miguu; kubalianeni mapema chakula kitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana, kabla akiba haijaisha. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C047.name: Kisarawe District Council
C047.documented: heavy rain, floods on coastal valleys, and landslides on the Pugu hills

area.en: Kisarawe: Pugu hills and forest reserves
area.sw: Kisarawe: milima ya Pugu na hifadhi za misitu

risk.en: This area has the Pugu hills and forest reserves where charcoal burning and dry-season fires degrade forest, and storms erode slopes and flood valley crossings.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina milima ya Pugu na hifadhi za misitu ambapo uchomaji mkaa na moto wa kiangazi huharibu misitu, na dhoruba humomonyoa miteremko na kufurika vivuko vya mabondeni.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to burn fields only under control, protect forest cover and build away from gullies and valley floors. What raises the risk: burning charcoal or clearing fields with fire on windy days, cutting the forest on the hill slopes, and building at gully mouths or on the valley floors. Know the cleared open ground your household will move to if a forest fire comes towards the houses, and the firm ground above the gullies you will go to when heavy rain sets in on the hills; report any fire at once. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuchoma mashamba kwa udhibiti tu, kulinda misitu na kujenga mbali na makorongo na sakafu za mabonde. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchoma mkaa au kusafisha mashamba kwa moto siku za upepo, kukata msitu kwenye miteremko ya milima, na kujenga kwenye midomo ya makorongo au sakafu za mabonde. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kaya yako itahamia moto wa msituni ukielekea nyumbani, na eneo imara juu ya makorongo mtakaloenda mvua kubwa inapoanza milimani; ripoti moto wowote mara moja. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C050.name: Mafia District Council
C050.documented: large waves, strong winds, rare tsunami, boat accidents, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Mafia: island villages and marine park
area.sw: Mafia: vijiji vya kisiwani na hifadhi ya bahari

risk.en: This area is an island where strong winds and rough seas cut boat and air links, coastal erosion affects villages and help can arrive slowly.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni kisiwa ambapo upepo mkali na bahari chafu hukata usafiri wa vyombo na ndege, mmomonyoko wa pwani huathiri vijiji na msaada unaweza kuchelewa kufika.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to stay ashore when strong winds are forecast, protect mangroves and keep food, water and medicine reserves. What raises the risk: setting out to sea or to the mainland in loaded boats when strong winds are forecast, building on the eroding beach, cutting mangroves and letting the island's food and medicine stocks run low before the rough season. Know the higher ground inland that your village will move to when a storm-tide or strong-wind warning is given, and restock before the rough season, because boats and planes may not come for days. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kubaki ufukweni upepo mkali unapotabiriwa, kulinda mikoko na kuweka akiba ya chakula, maji na dawa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka baharini au kwenda bara kwa vyombo vilivyojaa upepo mkali unapotabiriwa, kujenga kwenye ufukwe unaomomonyoka, kukata mikoko na kuacha akiba za chakula na dawa za kisiwa zipungue kabla ya msimu wa bahari chafu. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba au upepo mkali inapotolewa, na jazeni akiba kabla ya msimu wa bahari chafu, kwa sababu vyombo na ndege vinaweza kutokuja kwa siku kadhaa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C048.name: Mkuranga District Council
C048.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, and cholera

area.sw: Mkuranga: vijiji vya pwani na mashamba

risk.en: This area has coastal villages exposed to erosion and storm tides, and fast-growing farmland and industry near Dar es Salaam where storms flood low areas.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya pwani vinavyoathiriwa na mmomonyoko na mawimbi makubwa, na mashamba na viwanda vinavyokua kwa kasi karibu na Dar es Salaam ambapo dhoruba hufurika maeneo ya chini.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build back from the shoreline and stream banks, protect mangroves and keep drains open. What raises the risk: building on the beach front or the stream banks, cutting mangroves, mining sand from the shore and filling drains with waste or building over them. Know the higher ground inland that your household will move to when a storm-tide warning is given or the streams rise, and go before the water reaches the road. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe na kingo za vijito, kulinda mikoko na kuweka mitaro wazi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ufukweni au kwenye kingo za vijito, kukata mikoko, kuchimba mchanga ufukweni na kujaza mitaro taka au kujenga juu yake. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kaya yako itahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba inapotolewa au vijito vinapojaa, na ondokeni kabla maji hayajafika barabarani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C049.name: Rufiji District Council
C049.documented: Rufiji river and delta floods, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.sw: Rufiji: tambarare ya mafuriko ya mto Rufiji

risk.en: This area is the Rufiji flood plain, where the river floods villages and farms in wet years (as in 2024), cutting roads and spreading water-borne disease.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni tambarare ya mafuriko ya mto Rufiji, ambapo mto hufurika vijiji na mashamba katika miaka ya mvua nyingi (kama mwaka 2024), hukata barabara na kusambaza magonjwa yatokanayo na maji.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build on higher ground or raised plinths, keep food and seed above flood level and use safe water. What raises the risk: building new houses on the low flood plain, returning to the low ground while the river is still high, drinking flood water and letting seed and food sit at floor level; for new building choose ground above the flood line, and for houses already here know the exit and raise what you can. Know the raised ground and the dry route to it that your village will use when the Rufiji rises, move people, stores and animals there as soon as the committee or TMA gives the warning, and do not return until told; report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga sehemu za miinuko au kwenye misingi iliyoinuliwa, kuhifadhi chakula na mbegu juu ya kiwango cha mafuriko na kutumia maji salama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba mpya kwenye tambarare ya chini ya mafuriko, kurudi kwenye ardhi ya chini mto ukiwa bado umejaa, kunywa maji ya mafuriko na kuacha mbegu na chakula sakafuni; kwa ujenzi mpya chagueni ardhi iliyo juu ya mstari wa mafuriko, na kwa nyumba zilizopo tayari fahamu njia ya kutokea na inueni mnachoweza. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia Rufiji inapojaa, hamisheni watu, akiba na mifugo huko mara kamati au TMA inapotoa tahadhari, na msirudi hadi mtakapoambiwa; ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
